record.title: Establish stock thread coverage while the modeled device remains unavailable
record.intent: Prove a live Sparrow thread-set coverage gate before integrating further execution observation.
requirements: Use a fresh pinned guest and byte-identical stock APK/native library with the existing narrow admission fixture.
Validate process snapshot and absent device path before the bounded discovery observer starts.
Require all live stock TIDs traced and stopped in a converged inventory, or record the exact failure.
Do not create the device path, map a synthetic device or supply a register response; terminate and reap after the coverage snapshot.
Preserve enforcement, stable system_server and teardown evidence.
acceptance: Independent verification binds stock PID, all observed thread identities, observer ELF and complete cleanup.
State that coverage at a stopped boundary does not prove future signal handling, access ordering or initialization progress.
Commit and push the private control conclusion before the stock run.
